empowered-to-lead.quote: Empowered to Lead should be required reading for every leader and anyone aspiring to lead in any sphere of life.
empowered-to-lead.author: Empowered to Lead

empowered-to-lead.quote: Dr. Wilson combines his life experiences and knowledge of the Spirit’s work in the life of a leader to give us a resource that will help leaders turn their vision into reality.
Empowered to Lead reignites your passion for living out your purpose by refueling your faith.
empowered-to-lead.author: Empowered to Lead

empowered-to-lead.quote: This encouraging book will undoubtedly serve as an invaluable resource for anyone who desires to be a leader not just of people, but of transformation, all through the empowering presence of the Holy Spirit.
Developed through decades of leadership experience, everyone, regardless of their role or responsibilities, will benefit from Dr. Wilson’s wisdom and perspective.
What an edifying, powerful book. Every Spirit-filled leader should read it.

the-power-of-one.quote: The Power of One explains why and how each of us can do our part in reaching everyONE with the Good News that they matter to God, Christ’s died for them, and that He wants them in His family forever!
the-power-of-one.author: The Power of One

the-power-of-one.quote: Dr. Wilson reminds us that all people matter to God; all people have the ability to respond to the message of salvation, and all people can fulfill their God-given potential. The Power of One is a call to move beyond missiological thinking into missiological action and is a reminder that finishing the Great Commission is doable!
the-power-of-one.author: The Power of One

the-power-of-one.quote: If you are looking for a book that will challenge you to step out of your comfort zone and share the love of Christ with others, The Power of One is the book for you. I highly recommend it!
the-power-of-one.author: The Power of One

the-power-of-one.quote: With urgency in the pages, this book activates every believer to stand in this hour to declare that ‘Jesus Christ is Lord.’ This book will both challenge and inspire you to make your ‘Yes’ count for eternity.
the-power-of-one.author: – Nathan Morris, Founder and President, Shake The Nations Ministries

the-power-of-one.quote: I believe that after reading this book, every person will be moved by their heart to immediately finish the Great Commission. By 2033, everyone will have an authentic encounter with the Lord.
the-power-of-one.author: – Pastor Niko Njotorahardjo, Senior Pastor, Gereja Bethel Indonesia

the-power-of-one.quote: If our culture has shown us anything in recent years, it presents to us a world in desperate need of the good news of Jesus. The Power of One, offers both the challenge before us and the remarkable opportunity to proclaim the gospel in the power of the Spirit.
the-power-of-one.author: The Power of One

born-4-the-storm.quote: No matter your age or your relationship with this dynamic generation, this book is a must-read.
born-4-the-storm.author: – Samuel Rodriguez, New Season Church

born-4-the-storm.quote: I highly commend the man and his message.
born-4-the-storm.author: – Bill Johnson, Bethel Church

born-4-the-storm.quote: This is a must-read for any leader desiring to lead effectively in the future.
born-4-the-storm.author: – Teófilo Hayashi, Zion Church

born-4-the-storm.quote: Dr. Wilson has a passion, insight, and revelation that will empower and inspire whoever reads this book.
born-4-the-storm.author: – Russell Evans, PlanetShakers Church

born-4-the-storm.quote: This book is for Gen Z and about Gen Z! Everyone needs its wisdom!
born-4-the-storm.author: – Andy Byrd, Youth With A Mission

born-4-the-storm.quote: Finally! The book about generational change we've been looking for is here.
born-4-the-storm.author: – Phil Cooke, Ph.D., Author and Media Consultant

fasting-forward.quote: Fasting is one of the most misunderstood and neglected spiritual disciplines. In Fasting Forward, you will discover the biblical reasons for, and benefits of, this practice.
fasting-forward.author: – Christine Caine Founder, A21 and Propel Women

fasting-forward.quote: Dr. Billy Wilson skillfully shares insight into the importance of fasting with practical tips and strong biblical teaching. If you want to learn more about fasting and strengthen your relationship with God, this book is for you!
fasting-forward.author: – Russell Evans, Global Senior Pastor, Planetshakers Church

fasting-forward.quote: This latest work about the spiritual discipline of fasting by the president of one of the most prestigious Christian universities in the world proves that fasting stands the test of academic rigor in our most prestigious universities.
fasting-forward.author: – Jentezen Franklin, Senior Pastor, Free Chapel, NY Times Best-Selling Author

fasting-forward.quote: This book challenged, convicted, and inspired me in ways I didn’t expect. Fasting Forward will move you to embrace a deeper life of fasting. I pray you will read it and reap the vast blessings of fasting.
fasting-forward.author: – Brian Alarid, President, World Prays,Chairman, Pray For All

fasting-forward.quote: I have read many books on fasting, but this is by far one of the very best. Dr. Wilson has the ability to make this spiritual exercise one that every believer uses to release breakthrough in their life.
fasting-forward.author: – Cindy Jacobs, Founder, Generals International

fasting-forward.quote: Exploring the transformative power of fasting, this book offers a compelling look at how abstaining nourishes and strengthens one’s bond with the Lord, opening doors to profound personal and spiritual growth.
fasting-forward.author: – Dr. Mike Rakes, President, Evangel University

el-poder-de-uno.quote: El Poder de Uno explica por qué y cómo cada uno de nosotros podemos hacer nuestra parte para alcanzar a cada UNO con las Buenas Nuevas de que son importantes para Dios, que Cristo murió por ellos ¡y que Él los quiere en Su familia para siempre!
el-poder-de-uno.author: El Poder de Uno

el-poder-de-uno.quote: El Dr. Wilson nos recuerda que todas las personas son importantes para Dios; todas las personas tienen la capacidad de responder al mensaje de salvación, y todas las personas pueden realizar el potencial que Dios les ha dado. El Poder de Uno es un llamado de ir más allá del pensamiento misionológico hacia la acción misionológica y es un recordatorio de que terminar la Gran Comisión es factible.
el-poder-de-uno.author: El Poder de Uno

el-poder-de-uno.quote: Si estás buscando un libro que te desafíe a salir de tu zona de confort y compartir el amor de Cristo con los demás, El Poder de Uno es el libro para ti. ¡Lo recomiendo encarecidamente!
el-poder-de-uno.author: El Poder de Uno

el-poder-de-uno.quote: Con urgencia en sus páginas, este libro estimula a que cada creyente se ponga de pie en esta hora para declarar que 'Jesucristo es el Señor.' Este libro te desafiará e inspirará a hacer que tu 'Sí' cuente para la eternidad.
el-poder-de-uno.author: – Nathan Morris, Fundador y Presidente de Shake The Nations Ministries

el-poder-de-uno.quote: Creo que después de leer este libro, cada persona se sentirá conmovida en su corazón por terminar inmediatamente la Gran Comisión. Para el año 2033, cada 'uno' tendrá un encuentro auténtico con el Señor Jesucristo.
el-poder-de-uno.author: – Pastor Niko Njotorahardjo, Pastor Principal, Gereja Bethel Indonesia

el-poder-de-uno.quote: Si algo nos ha enseñado nuestra cultura en los últimos años es que nos presenta un mundo que necesita desesperadamente las Buenas Nuevas de Jesús. En El Poder de Uno, el Dr. Billy Wilson ofrece tanto el desafío que tenemos ante nosotros como la extraordinaria oportunidad de proclamar el Evangelio en el poder del Espíritu.
el-poder-de-uno.author: El Poder de Uno

ayunar-para-avanzar.quote: El ayuno es una de las disciplinas espirituales más malentendidas y descuidadas. En Ayunar para avanzar, descubrirás las razones bíblicas y los beneficios de esta práctica. Este libro te ayudará a construir tu fe y tu intimidad con Dios.
ayunar-para-avanzar.author: – Christine Caine, Fundadora de A21 y Propel Women

ayunar-para-avanzar.quote: El Dr. Billy Wilson expone hábilmente una visión sobre la importancia del ayuno y el papel que debe desempeñar en la vida de cada creyente. Si deseas aprender más sobre el ayuno, fortalecer tu relación con Dios y acercarte a Él de formas nuevas, ¡este libro es para ti!
ayunar-para-avanzar.author: – Russell Evans, Pastor principal global de Planetshakers Church

ayunar-para-avanzar.quote: Esta última obra sobre la disciplina espiritual del ayuno por el presidente de una de las universidades cristianas más prestigiosas del mundo demuestra una vez más que el ayuno no solo resulta provechoso para cada creyente, sino que también resiste el análisis del rigor académico en los venerados pasillos de nuestras universidades más prestigiosas.
ayunar-para-avanzar.author: – Jentezen Franklin, Pastor principal de Free Chapel; Autor de best sellers del The New York Times

ayunar-para-avanzar.quote: Este libro me desafió, me convenció y me inspiró de maneras que no esperaba. Ayunar para avanzar te moverá a abrazar una vida más profunda de ayuno. Oro para que lo leas, lo apliques y coseches las abundantes bendiciones del ayuno.
ayunar-para-avanzar.author: – Brian Alarid, Presidente de World Prays; Presidente de Pray For All

ayunar-para-avanzar.quote: He leído muchos libros sobre el ayuno, pero este es uno de los mejores. El Dr. Wilson tiene la capacidad de hablar directamente al corazón y hacer de este ejercicio espiritual algo asequible para todo creyente que desee experimentar una gran transformación y avance en su vida.
ayunar-para-avanzar.author: – Dr. Cindy Jacobs, Fundadora de Generals International

ayunar-para-avanzar.quote: Al explorar el poder transformador del ayuno, este libro argumenta de manera convincente sobre cómo la abstinencia no solo nutre el alma, sino que también fortalece el vínculo del creyente con el Señor, y abre puertas a un profundo crecimiento personal y espiritual.
ayunar-para-avanzar.author: – Dr. Mike Rakes, Presidente de Evangel University
